convergence.interpretation: Operational stopping rule for sampling; nominal uncertainties after sequential inspection are descriptive, not coverage guarantees.
convergence.window_fit_diagnostics: Cost and cutoff Z<2 for full40ps, both20ps windows, and the newest5-replica fit are required in addition to the main rule.

duration_policy: Primary refinement combines verified legacy20ps spectra with two20ps segments per new40ps replica; trajectories are never joined across boundaries. New40ps/first20/second20 estimates and new5 remain separately reported.
restart_policy: One initial guarded sbatch for this temperature;20h allocations continue only by same-ID requeue at a completed-replica boundary. PBE jobs must never be restarted.
preparation_note: New independent seeded reservoir from archived pureTi configuration,20psNPT then5psNPT+1psNVT+40psNVT per newreplica;legacy preparation remains separately identified.

scheduling.policy: Independent temperature job;analyze after5,10,and every5;four jobs submitted together,oneA100 each;actual concurrency limited by cluster GPUs.

pooling.weight: Equal-length20ps channels pooled without temporal concatenation;ownV/(kB*T),fivechannels
pooling.uncertainty: max(formalSE,delete-one-whole-replica cluster jackknifeSE);both halves removed together for newreplicas
pooling.new40_stop_rule: Retain full original heuristic includingNnew>=30,neff40>=60,two consecutive passes;old20ps do not substitute for40ps duration checks
pooling.legacy_model_validation: All archived zero-step pressures must match checkpoint23200 before submission
